about.slide1: It was during the technical course at IFC, in Concórdia, that class projects grew into something bigger: first place at the Agro Hackathon, first place at Consórcio Itá's Science Fair, research at the Scientific Initiation Exhibition and a paper at Latinoware. Today I'm a developer at Arpa Sistemas, still building complete systems, from the API to the data...
about.slide2: What drives me is using technology on real problems: the energy of a micro hydro plant, the carbon of a commute, the books of a small business. The gallery holds the behind-the-scenes of those fairs, presentations and tests.
